Priority – Local music scene

Please prioritise moments that show how the festival supports young musicians, music education and small businesses in the town.

Key timestamps:

02:10 – How the festival started
05:45 – Volunteers building the main stage
21:30 – Interview with the music school about scholarships
1:02:15 – Closing night conversation about the town's future

Creative freedom
You can combine footage from across the video and build montages, as long as each clip connects back to the festival's community impact.

Content to avoid / flag:

0:31 - 0:40 (this should not be included in any content)
Faces of children: 07:12, 18:05 – blur/crop.
Third-party branding: 09:50, 33:20 – avoid prominent logos.
Copyright music: 14:02 – avoid uncleared audio.
Sensitive topics: 26:40 (local election).
Other: 40:00 (sponsor presentation) – flag for review; 44:44 (smoking) – avoid.

Overall: warm, organic content that gets people talking about live music in their town.
